newsitem.title: USA: Gulfstream IPO prices at $24/shr - Goldman.
newsitem.headline: Gulfstream IPO prices at $24/shr - Goldman.

text.p: Corporate jet aircraft maker Gulfstream Aerospace Corp's initial public offering of 37 million shares was priced at $24 a share, said Goldman Sachs, the lead underwriter.
The price was at the high end of the range of $22 to $24 a share and the company is offering more than the 28.0 million shares than expected.
Gulfstream, which is owned by certain partnerships formed by the Forstmann Little & Co investment firm, was expected to have about 71.96 million shares outstanding, excluding over-allotments.
Proceeds of the offering will be used to repurchase Gulfstream's Series A 7 percent cumulative preferred stock valued at $450 million and repay existing debt, the company said in its prospectus.
Despite the larger than expected offering, analysts have mixed opinions about the stock.

Analysts said Gulfstream's G-V corporate jet, which sells for about $30 million and holds 19 passengers, has enjoyed a one-year lead on the competition, but Boeing Co and Bombardier Inc are expected to offer competing products in 1997.
Gulfstream has an order backlog valued at $3.0 billion as of September 16, 1996.
